answer: Continuous Work Ledger. Each identity must publish a ferrous hash-chain of solved micro-tasks; a new identity’s chain is cheaper to forge only until peers demand a shared anchor of prior chain heads. Settlement clears through a slow river of batch audits, so flooding identities incur rising per-identity audit and storage costs, while honest ones amortize. An attacker pays the marginal audit fee plus orphaned chain work for every fake identity, scaling superlinearly with count.
